item.title: Sydney to Celebrate 100 Years of Greek Music Icon Mimis Plessas

item.title: Ilia Regional Leader Offers €1,000 Personal Incentive to Women Staying in Oleni Village
item.description: The regional government official in Ilia, Giorgos Dimitropoulos, has personally pledged €1,000 from his salary to every woman in the village of Oleni who chooses to stay permanently or raise her children there. The initiative aims to support families, encourage motherhood, and combat rural depopulation in western Greece’s small communities. item.title: Kimolos Captivates International Media: Greece’s Hidden Cycladic Gem “Waiting to Be Discovered
item.description: Kimolos is gaining international acclaim as an underrated Cycladic paradise, with British Express and Travel and Tour World praising its unspoiled landscapes, authentic charm, crystal-clear waters (ranked among the world's cleanest), and serene atmosphere. item.title: Bomb Squad Investigates Motorcycle Outside Bank of Greece
item.description: Athens police, firefighters, and a bomb disposal unit are currently inspecting a suspicious motorcycle outside the Bank of Greece on Omirou Street in central Athens. Authorities have closed access to Omirou Street while the inspection continues to ensure public safety. No injuries or further incidents have been reported so far. item.title: Plane Crash in Northern Colombia Kills All 15 Onboard
item.description: A Beechcraft 1900D aircraft crashed on Wednesday in a mountainous area of northern Colombia, killing all 15 passengers, Colombian civil aviation authorities confirmed.
